description: Find scanned JavaScript detected as a given library (for example 'react', 'jquery' or 'nextjs'; 'Next.js' is accepted for 'nextjs'), optionally one version or a version pattern, with a version breakdown and CDN distribution; paginated with page and per_page.

include_cdn_only.description: Include scripts identified only by their CDN URL.
include_cdn_only.title: Include Cdn Only

library_name.description: Library name, for example react, jquery or nextjs ('Next.js' is also accepted).
library_name.title: Library Name

version.description: Only this exact version, for example 3.7.1.
version.title: Version

version_pattern.description: Only versions matching this pattern, for example 3.*.
version_pattern.title: Version Pattern

name: search_js_fingerprint_by_library
title: Search JS Fingerprint By Library
